ar.title: خطط AI Music لفيديو توظيف من دون ان تجعل الوظيفة تبدو مزيفة
ar.description: Workflow عملي لفيديوهات employer brand: candidate promise map, music bed واضح للكلام, captions, export checks, وapproval notes.
body: فريق التوظيف يريد فيديو قصيرا: لقطات مكتب، جملة من المدير، ضحكة في الممر، وCTA للتقديم. المشكلة ان الموسيقى قد تجعل كل شيء يبدو اكبر من الحقيقة. اذا بدا الtrack كاعلان ملحمي بينما الفيديو يقول وظيفة يومية حقيقية، يشعر المرشح ان هناك طبقة polish تخفي التفاصيل. Recruitment video music يجب ان تجعل الوعد اوضح، لا ان تخترع ثقة لا تثبتها اللقطات.
## ما هي EasyMusic.AI؟

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ar/ai-music-generator) منصة لصناعة music drafts من text prompts وlyrics وstyle direction. اذا كان وصف الصوت عاما جدا، يساعد [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/music-style-generator) على تحويل كلمات مثل warm, focused, team energy الى style brief ادق. وبعد اختيار نسخة، يمكن ان يساعد [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/ar/tools/audio-converter) في تجهيز format عملي، بينما تبقى approvals والحقوق ومراجعة الplatform خطوات منفصلة.
## ابدأ بخريطة ثقة المرشح

قبل prompt، اكتب اربعة اعمدة: scene, proof, candidate promise, music job. Scene قد تكون team standup، warehouse floor، remote desk، او customer call. Proof هو ما يراه المرشح فعلا: اداة، شخص يتكلم، pace العمل، او بيئة المكان. Candidate promise هو الانطباع الذي يجب ان يخرج به: clarity, support, craft, autonomy, stability. Music job يشرح ما تحتاجه اللقطة: calm pulse, small lift, quiet hold, او clean ending.
## اترك الكلام والتفاصيل تقود

اذا كان الفيديو فيه quote من موظف او hiring manager، اجعل الكلمات في المقدمة. لا تضع vocal hook فوق job title, salary range, benefit detail, location, او caption مهم. كثير من viewers يشاهدون social feeds بصوت منخفض او mute، لذلك يجب ان تعمل الصورة والcaptions اولا. الموسيقى تضيف tone عندما يكون الصوت مفعلا، لكنها لا تصلح وعدا غامضا او لقطة لا تشرح الوظيفة.
## اكتب Prompt متزنا

Prompt جيد قد يكون: instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card. داخل EasyMusic.AI، اختبر نسخة restrained ونسخة brighter على نفس edit. اذا جعلت النسخة brighter الشركة تبدو اكبر او افخم من الواقع، احتفظ بالنسخة الاكثر هدوءا.
## جهز نسخا للمنصات

لا تعتمد على export واحد. اصنع 15 ثانية للsocial cut، 30 او 45 ثانية لصفحة الوظيفة، ونسخة interview bed اذا كان الكلام اطول. احتفظ ببداية نظيفة لا تصطدم مع اول caption، وبنهاية قصيرة لا تغطي CTA. اذا كانت الوجهة LinkedIn او YouTube او صفحة careers داخلية، افحص specs, captions, disclosure expectations, file format, والapproval workflow قبل النشر.
## افكار قابلة للاستخدام اليوم

- اكتب وعدا واحدا فقط لكل فيديو: supportive team، focused craft، fast learning، او calm operations.
- ضع marker موسيقيا خفيفا بعد اول proof visual، لا قبله.
- اختبر الفيديو على laptop speaker وصوت منخفض قبل headphones.
- احفظ prompt واسم الملف ومن وافق عليه بجانب job campaign.
- اعد مراجعة الفيديو اذا تغيرت الوظيفة، الbenefits، location، او الteam footage.
## مراجعة قبل النشر

اسأل شخصا ليس في فريق التوظيف: هل تفهم طبيعة الوظيفة خلال اول عشر ثوان؟ هل تبدو الموسيقى داعمة ام مبالغة؟ هل يمكن قراءة captions من دون الصوت؟ هل اي لقطة توحي بوعد لا يظهر في job description؟ لا تفترض ان AI-generated track مناسب تلقائيا لكل حملة او بلد. راجع شروط الاداة، قواعد الplatform، واستخدام الموظفين او المرشحين في اللقطات.

## FAQ
### هل يجب ان يكون فيديو التوظيف upbeat دائما؟
لا. Upbeat جيد اذا كانت اللقطات تثبت الطاقة. لو كانت الوظيفة هادئة او دقيقة، فpulse اخف اكثر صدقا.
### هل يمكن استخدام vocals؟
غالبا تجنبها في recruitment videos التي تحتوي كلاما او captions. Vocal hook ينافس الرسالة والاسم الوظيفي.
### ما طول الcue المناسب؟
اكتب cue اطول قليلا من edit الحالي مع clean handles. نسخ 15 و30 و45 ثانية تغطي معظم الاستخدامات.
### ماذا افعل اذا سيشاهد الناس الفيديو mute؟
اجعل اول visual وcaption يشرحان الدور. الموسيقى تصبح مكافأة عند تشغيل الصوت، لا مصدر الفهم الوحيد.

de.title: Plane AI Music fuer Recruiting-Videos, ohne den Job unecht wirken zu lassen
de.description: Ein praktischer Workflow fuer Employer-Brand-Videos: Candidate Promise Map, sprachsicheres Music Bed, Captions, Export-Checks und Freigaben.
body: Das Recruiting-Team braucht einen kurzen Clip: Buero, ein Satz vom Hiring Manager, ein Lachen im Flur, ein Apply-now-Ende. Der heikle Teil ist die Musik. Wenn der Track nach grossem Imagefilm klingt, die Bilder aber einen normalen Arbeitstag zeigen, wirkt der Job schnell geschminkt. Recruitment video music sollte ein echtes Versprechen klarer machen, nicht Vertrauen erzeugen, das das Material nicht belegt.
## Was ist EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/de/ai-music-generator) ist eine Plattform, mit der du Musikentwuerfe aus Textprompts, Lyrics und Stilrichtungen erstellst. Wenn dir die Soundbeschreibung noch zu grob ist, kann der [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/music-style-generator) Begriffe wie warm, focused oder team energy in ein genaueres Style Brief uebersetzen. Nach der Auswahl kann der [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/de/tools/audio-converter) ein praktisches Format vorbereiten; Freigaben, Rechte und Plattformregeln bleiben eigene Pruefschritte.
## Beginne mit einer Candidate Trust Map

Schreibe vor dem Prompt vier Spalten: scene, proof, candidate promise, music job. Scene kann Team Standup, Lagerflaeche, Remote Desk oder Customer Call sein. Proof ist das, was Kandidaten wirklich sehen: Werkzeug, Mensch, Arbeitsrhythmus, Umgebung. Candidate promise ist der Eindruck, der bleiben soll: clarity, support, craft, autonomy, stability. Music job sagt, was die Szene braucht: calm pulse, small lift, quiet hold oder clean ending.
## Lass Sprache und Details fuehren

Wenn ein Mitarbeiter oder Hiring Manager spricht, gehoeren die Worte nach vorn. Lege keine Vocal Hook ueber Jobtitel, Gehaltsspanne, Benefit-Detail, Standort oder wichtige Caption. Viele Menschen sehen Social Feeds leise oder stumm, also muessen Bild und Captions zuerst funktionieren. Musik gibt Ton und Tempo, wenn Sound an ist, aber sie repariert kein vages Jobversprechen und keine unklare Szene.
## Schreibe einen geerdeten Prompt

Ein brauchbarer Prompt: instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card. In EasyMusic.AI teste eine restrained Version und eine brighter Version gegen denselben Schnitt. Wenn die brighter Version die Firma groesser oder glaenzender wirken laesst als das Material, nimm die ruhigere.
## Erstelle Versionen fuer die Platzierung

Verlasse dich nicht auf einen Export. Baue 15 Sekunden fuer Social Cuts, 30 oder 45 Sekunden fuer die Jobseite und ein eigenes Interview Bed fuer laengere Sprache. Halte den Anfang sauber, damit die erste Caption nicht dagegenkaempft, und das Ende kurz, damit die CTA nicht verschwindet. Fuer LinkedIn, YouTube oder interne Career Pages pruefe Specs, Captions, Disclosure-Erwartungen, Dateiformat und Freigabeprozess.
## Sofort nutzbare Ideen

- Waehle pro Video nur ein Versprechen: supportive team, focused craft, fast learning oder calm operations.
- Setze den musikalischen Marker nach dem ersten Proof Visual, nicht davor.
- Teste auf Laptop-Lautsprechern und niedriger Lautstaerke vor dem Kopfhoerer-Check.
- Speichere Prompt, Dateiname und Freigabe neben der Jobkampagne.
- Pruefe neu, wenn Rolle, Benefits, Standort oder Team Footage wechseln.
## Review vor der Veroeffentlichung

Bitte jemanden ausserhalb des Recruiting-Teams um einen kalten Blick: Versteht man in den ersten zehn Sekunden die Rolle? Unterstuetzt die Musik oder uebertreibt sie? Sind Captions ohne Ton lesbar? Deutet eine Szene ein Versprechen an, das nicht in der Jobbeschreibung steht? Gehe nicht davon aus, dass ein AI-generated track automatisch fuer jede Kampagne oder jedes Land passt. Pruefe Tool Terms, Plattformregeln und die Nutzung von Mitarbeiter- oder Kandidatenaufnahmen.

## FAQ
### Muss Recruiting-Musik immer upbeat sein?
Nein. Upbeat passt, wenn das Material echte Energie zeigt. Fuer ruhige, praezise Arbeit ist ein leichter Pulse oft glaubwuerdiger.
### Sind Vocals sinnvoll?
Meist nicht, wenn Sprache oder Captions wichtig sind. Eine Vocal Hook konkurriert mit Jobtitel und Message.
### Wie lang sollte der Cue sein?
Etwas laenger als der aktuelle Schnitt, mit sauberen Handles. 15-, 30- und 45-Sekunden-Versionen decken viele Einsaetze ab.
### Was, wenn das Video stumm gesehen wird?
Das erste Bild und die erste Caption muessen die Rolle erklaeren. Musik belohnt Sound-on, darf aber nicht die einzige Informationsquelle sein.

en.title: Plan AI Music for Recruitment Videos Without Making the Job Sound Fake
en.description: A practical workflow for employer-brand videos: candidate promise maps, speech-safe music beds, captions, export checks, and approval notes.
body: The hiring team needs a short video: a few workplace shots, one line from the manager, a quick team moment, and an apply-now card. The risky part is the music. If the track sounds like a glossy launch film while the footage shows an ordinary working day, candidates feel the polish before they trust the message. Recruitment video music should make a real promise easier to read, not supply trust the footage has not earned.
## What is EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/ai-music-generator) is an AI music creation platform for turning text prompts, lyrics, and style direction into music drafts. If your sound brief is still vague, the [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/tools/music-style-generator) can help turn words like warm, focused, or team energy into a clearer style brief. After you choose a version, the [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/tools/audio-converter) can help prepare a practical delivery format, while approvals, rights review, and platform rules stay separate.
## Start With a Candidate Trust Map

Before writing the prompt, make four columns: scene, proof, candidate promise, music job. A scene might be a team standup, warehouse floor, remote desk, lab bench, or customer call. Proof is what the candidate actually sees: a tool, a person speaking, the pace of work, or the physical environment. Candidate promise is the impression you want to leave: clarity, support, craft, autonomy, stability. Music job says what the cue should do: calm pulse, small lift, quiet hold, or clean ending.
## Let Speech and Details Lead

If an employee or hiring manager speaks, keep the words in front. Do not place a vocal hook over the job title, salary range, benefit detail, location, or an important caption. Many people meet recruitment videos in feeds that begin quietly or muted, so the picture and captions need to work first. Music adds tone when sound is on, but it cannot repair a vague role promise or footage that does not explain the job.
## Prompt a Grounded Cue

A useful prompt might be: instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card. Inside EasyMusic.AI, test one restrained version and one brighter version against the same edit. If the brighter cue makes the company feel larger or slicker than the footage supports, keep the quieter option.
## Make Versions for Each Placement

Do not rely on one export. Make a 15-second social cut, a 30- or 45-second careers-page version, and a separate interview bed if the video includes longer speech. Keep a clean start that does not crash into the first caption, and a short ending that leaves the apply card readable. If the destination is LinkedIn, YouTube, or an internal careers page, check specs, captions, disclosure expectations, file format, and the approval workflow before upload.
## Reusable Ideas You Can Apply Today

- Pick only one promise per video: supportive team, focused craft, fast learning, or calm operations.
- Put the musical marker after the first proof visual, not before it.
- Test on a laptop speaker at low volume before judging on headphones.
- Save the prompt, file name, and approver beside the job campaign.
- Re-review the video if the role, benefits, location, or team footage changes.
## Review Before Publishing

Ask someone outside the hiring team to watch cold. Can they understand the role in the first ten seconds? Does the music support the people on screen, or does it exaggerate them? Are captions readable without sound? Does any shot imply a promise that is not in the job description? Do not assume an AI-generated track fits every campaign, country, or platform automatically. Check tool terms, platform rules, and the use of employee or candidate footage before handoff.

## FAQ
### Should recruitment music always be upbeat?
No. Upbeat works when the footage proves real energy. For quieter or more precise roles, a lighter pulse often feels more honest.
### Can I use vocals?
Usually avoid them when the video has speech or captions. A vocal hook competes with the job title, the speaker, and the call to apply.
### How long should the cue be?
Make it slightly longer than the current edit, with clean handles. Separate 15-, 30-, and 45-second versions cover most publishing needs.
### What if people watch the video muted?
Make the first visual and caption explain the role. Music should reward sound-on viewing, not carry the only useful information.

## Escribe un cue con los pies en la tierra

Prompt util: instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card. Dentro de EasyMusic.AI, prueba una version restrained y una brighter con el mismo edit. ## Revision antes de publicar

Pide a alguien fuera del equipo de hiring que lo vea sin contexto. Entiende el rol en los primeros diez segundos? La musica apoya a las personas o las exagera? Los captions se leen sin sonido? Alguna toma sugiere una promesa que no esta en la job description? No asumas que un AI-generated track sirve automaticamente para toda campana, pais o plataforma. Revisa terminos de la herramienta, reglas de plataforma y uso de footage de empleados o candidatos antes del handoff.

## FAQ
### La musica de recruiting siempre debe ser upbeat?
No. Upbeat funciona cuando las tomas prueban energia real. Para roles mas tranquilos o precisos, un pulse ligero suele sentirse mas honesto.
### Puedo usar vocals?
Normalmente evitalos si hay speech o captions. Un vocal hook compite con el job title, la persona que habla y el call to apply.
### Cuanto debe durar el cue?
Hazlo un poco mas largo que el edit actual, con handles limpios. Versiones de 15, 30 y 45 segundos cubren la mayoria de usos.
### Que pasa si se ve en mute?
Haz que el primer visual y caption expliquen el rol. La musica debe premiar el sound-on, no llevar la unica informacion util.

Molti vedono recruitment videos in feed che partono bassi o in mute, quindi immagine e captions devono funzionare prima. La musica aggiunge tono quando il suono e attivo, ma non ripara una promessa vaga o footage che non spiega il lavoro.
## Scrivi una cue credibile

Prompt utile: instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card. In EasyMusic.AI, prova una versione restrained e una brighter sullo stesso edit. Se la brighter fa sembrare l azienda piu grande o lucida del footage, scegli quella piu calma.
## Prepara versioni per ogni placement

Non affidarti a un solo export. Crea un social cut da 15 secondi, una versione da 30 o 45 secondi per la careers page e un interview bed separato se c e parlato lungo. Mantieni un inizio pulito che non urti la prima caption e una fine corta che lasci leggibile la card apply. Se la destinazione e LinkedIn, YouTube o una pagina career interna, verifica specs, captions, disclosure expectations, file format e workflow di approvazione prima dell upload.
## Idee riutilizzabili

- Scegli una sola promessa per video: supportive team, focused craft, fast learning o calm operations.
- Metti il marker musicale dopo il primo proof visual, non prima.
- Testa su laptop speaker a basso volume prima delle headphones.
- Salva prompt, nome file e approvatore accanto alla job campaign.
- Rivedi il video se cambiano ruolo, benefits, location o team footage.
## Review prima della pubblicazione

Chiedi a qualcuno fuori dal team recruiting di guardare senza contesto. Capisce il ruolo nei primi dieci secondi? La musica supporta le persone o le esagera? Le captions si leggono senza suono? Qualche shot suggerisce una promessa assente dalla job description? Non dare per scontato che un AI-generated track vada bene automaticamente per ogni campagna, paese o piattaforma. Controlla tool terms, regole di piattaforma e uso del footage di employee o candidate prima dell handoff.

## FAQ
### La musica recruiting deve essere sempre upbeat?
No. Upbeat funziona se il footage prova energia reale. Per ruoli piu calmi o precisi, un pulse leggero spesso sembra piu onesto.
### Posso usare vocals?
Di solito evita vocals quando ci sono speech o captions. Una vocal hook compete con job title, speaker e call to apply.
### Quanto deve durare la cue?
Un po piu dell edit attuale, con handles puliti. Versioni da 15, 30 e 45 secondi coprono molti usi.
### E se il video viene visto in mute?
Il primo visual e la prima caption devono spiegare il ruolo. La musica premia il sound-on, non deve portare l unica informazione utile.

使いやすいpromptはこうです: instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card。EasyMusic.AIでは、同じeditに対してrestrained versionとbrighter versionを比べます。Brighter cueがfootage以上に会社を大きくslickに見せるなら、静かな選択を残します。

### Recruiting musicは常にupbeatにすべきですか？

pt.title: Planeje Musica IA para Recruitment Videos sem Deixar a Vaga Parecer Falsa
pt.description: Workflow pratico para employer-brand videos: candidate promise map, music bed seguro para fala, captions, export checks e aprovacoes.
body: O time de hiring precisa de um video curto: algumas cenas do trabalho, uma frase do manager, um momento de equipe e uma card de apply now. O risco esta na musica. Se a faixa soa como filme de lancamento polido enquanto o footage mostra um dia comum de trabalho, candidatos percebem o polish antes de confiar na mensagem. Musica de recruitment video deve tornar uma promessa real mais facil de ler, nao fornecer uma confianca que a imagem nao conquistou.
## O que e EasyMusic.AI?

[EasyMusic.AI](https://easymusic.ai/pt/ai-music-generator) e uma plataforma de criacao musical com IA para transformar text prompts, letras e direcao de estilo em music drafts. Se o brief sonoro ainda esta vago, o [Music Style Generator](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/music-style-generator) pode converter warm, focused ou team energy em um style brief mais claro. Depois de escolher uma versao, o [Audio Converter](https://easymusic.ai/pt/tools/audio-converter) pode ajudar a preparar um formato pratico; aprovacoes, direitos e regras de plataforma continuam sendo revisoes separadas.
## Comece com um Candidate Trust Map

Antes do prompt, crie quatro colunas: scene, proof, candidate promise, music job. Uma scene pode ser team standup, warehouse floor, remote desk, lab bench ou customer call. Proof e o que o candidato realmente ve: ferramenta, pessoa falando, ritmo de trabalho ou ambiente fisico. Candidate promise e a impressao desejada: clarity, support, craft, autonomy, stability. Music job diz o que o cue precisa fazer: calm pulse, small lift, quiet hold ou clean ending.
## Deixe voz e detalhes liderarem

Se um employee ou hiring manager fala, mantenha as palavras na frente. Nao coloque vocal hook sobre job title, salary range, benefit detail, location ou caption importante. Muitas pessoas encontram recruitment videos em feeds que comecam baixos ou em mute, entao imagem e captions precisam funcionar primeiro. A musica adiciona tom quando o som esta ligado, mas nao corrige uma promessa vaga ou footage que nao explica a vaga.
## Escreva um cue com pe no chao

Prompt util: instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card. No EasyMusic.AI, teste uma versao restrained e uma brighter no mesmo edit. Se a brighter faz a empresa parecer maior ou mais polida do que o footage sustenta, fique com a opcao mais calma.
## Crie versoes para cada placement

Nao dependa de um unico export. Faca um social cut de 15 segundos, uma versao de 30 ou 45 segundos para careers page e um interview bed separado se houver fala longa. Mantenha um inicio limpo que nao bata na primeira caption e um final curto que deixe a card de apply legivel. Se o destino for LinkedIn, YouTube ou pagina interna de carreiras, revise specs, captions, disclosure expectations, file format e approval workflow antes do upload.
## Ideias reutilizaveis

- Escolha apenas uma promessa por video: supportive team, focused craft, fast learning ou calm operations.
- Coloque o marker musical depois do primeiro proof visual, nao antes.
- Teste em speaker de laptop com volume baixo antes de julgar em headphones.
- Salve prompt, nome do arquivo e aprovador ao lado da job campaign.
- Refaça a review se role, benefits, location ou team footage mudarem.
## Review antes de publicar

Peca a alguem fora do time de hiring para assistir sem contexto. A pessoa entende o role nos primeiros dez segundos? A musica apoia quem aparece ou exagera? As captions sao legiveis sem som? Algum shot implica uma promessa que nao esta na job description? Nao assuma que um AI-generated track serve automaticamente para toda campanha, pais ou plataforma. Confira tool terms, regras da plataforma e uso de footage de employees ou candidates antes do handoff.

## FAQ
### A musica de recruiting deve ser sempre upbeat?
Nao. Upbeat funciona quando o footage prova energia real. Para roles mais calmos ou precisos, um pulse leve costuma soar mais honesto.
### Posso usar vocals?
Normalmente evite quando ha speech ou captions. Um vocal hook compete com job title, speaker e call to apply.
### Quanto tempo o cue deve ter?
Um pouco mais que o edit atual, com handles limpos. Versoes de 15, 30 e 45 segundos cobrem a maioria dos usos.
### E se o video for visto em mute?
O primeiro visual e caption devem explicar o role. A musica deve recompensar sound-on viewing, nao carregar a unica informacao util.

## FAQ

可用 prompt：instrumental employer brand video bed, 42 seconds, warm indie pop pulse, light percussion, grounded optimism, no vocal hook, no corporate anthem, small lift during team walkthrough, soft ending under apply now card。在 EasyMusic.AI 中，用同一个 edit 测试 restrained version 和 brighter version。如果 brighter cue 让公司显得比画面支持的更大、更光滑，保留更安静的选择。
## 为每个 Placement 做 Version

不要只依赖一个 export。做 15-second social cut、30 或 45-second careers-page version；如果有较长 speech，再做单独的 interview bed。保持 clean start，避免撞上第一条 caption；结尾要短，让 apply card 可读。如果目的地是 LinkedIn、YouTube 或 internal careers page，上传前检查 specs、captions、disclosure expectations、file format 和 approval workflow。
## 今天就能用的 Ideas

- 每支 video 只选一个 promise：supportive team、focused craft、fast learning 或 calm operations。
- Musical marker 放在第一个 proof visual 之后，不要放在之前。
- 先用 laptop speaker 和 low volume 测试，再用 headphones 判断。
- 把 prompt、file name 和 approver 与 job campaign 放在一起。
- 如果 role、benefits、location 或 team footage 改了，重新 review video。
## 发布前 Review

请 hiring team 之外的人在没有 context 的情况下观看。前十秒能理解 role 吗？Music 是支持画面里的人，还是把他们夸大了？Captions 在无声时能读吗？有没有 shot 暗示了 job description 里没有的 promise？不要假设 AI-generated track 会自动适合每个 campaign、country 或 platform。Handoff 前检查 tool terms、platform rules，以及 employee 或 candidate footage 的使用方式。

## FAQ
### Recruitment music 一定要 upbeat 吗？
不一定。只有 footage 证明真实 energy 时，upbeat 才合适。更安静或更精确的 role，light pulse 往往更诚实。
### 可以用 vocals 吗？
如果 video 有 speech 或 captions，通常避免。Vocal hook 会和 job title、speaker、call to apply 竞争。
### Cue 应该多长？
比当前 edit 稍长，并保留 clean handles。15、30、45 秒 version 可以覆盖大多数发布需求。
### 如果大家 mute 观看怎么办？
让第一个 visual 和 caption 说明 role。Music 应该奖励 sound-on viewing，而不是承载唯一有用信息。
